parts.script:
Welcome to the Riverside Language School. This is part one of the listening test. Listen to a conversation between a student and a receptionist.

Receptionist: Good morning, Riverside Language School. How can I help you?
Student: Good morning. I'd like some information about your evening English classes, please.
Receptionist: Of course. Are you a complete beginner, or have you studied English before?
Student: I studied English at school, but that was a long time ago. I'd say I'm at an intermediate level.
Receptionist: Right. Our intermediate class meets every Tuesday and Thursday, from six thirty to eight thirty in the evening.
Student: That works well for me, because I finish work at five. How much does the course cost?
Receptionist: It's one hundred and twenty pounds for the ten-week course, and that includes all the course materials.
Student: And do I need to buy a course book separately?
Receptionist: No, the book is included in that price. But there is a small registration fee of fifteen pounds when you first enrol.
Student: I see. And could you tell me when the next course begins?
Receptionist: The next course starts on the fourteenth of September, and you can enrol any time before that date.
Student: Great. Thank you very much for your help.
Receptionist: You're welcome. Have a nice day.

questions.explanation: The student says 'I'd say I'm at an intermediate level', and the receptionist says classes meet 'every Tuesday and Thursday'.

questions.explanation: The receptionist says 'It's one hundred and twenty pounds for the ten-week course'.

questions.explanation: The receptionist says the course 'starts on the fourteenth of September'.

parts.script:
Now listen to a short talk given to new students about the college library.

Good afternoon everyone, and welcome to the college library. Before you begin your studies, I'd like to give you a few practical details. The library is open from eight in the morning until ten at night on weekdays, and from nine until five at weekends. Your student card is also your library card, so please carry it with you at all times.

You can borrow up to six books at a time, and the loan period is three weeks. If you need a book for longer, you can renew it twice, as long as nobody else has requested it. DVDs and language CDs are kept behind the main desk, so please ask a member of staff if you'd like one of those.

The quiet study area is on the second floor, and the group study rooms are on the ground floor. You need to book the group rooms in advance, and you can do this either at the desk or online. Finally, a reminder that food and drink are not allowed anywhere in the library except in the café on the ground floor.

questions.explanation: The speaker says the library is open 'from eight in the morning until ten at night on weekdays'.

questions.question: No more than two words: How many books can a student borrow at once?
questions.explanation: The speaker says 'You can borrow up to six books at a time'.

questions.question: Where are the group study rooms located?
questions.explanation: The speaker says 'the group study rooms are on the ground floor'.

questions.question: Complete the notes. Write no more than TWO WORDS for each answer.
questions.explanation: The speaker states the borrowing limit is 'six books' and the loan period is 'three weeks'.
